inlines.v: PRETO'RIAN, adjective Belonging to a pretor or judge; judicial; exercised by the pretor; as pretorian power or authority. Pretorian bands or guards, in Roman history, were the emperor's guards. Their number was ultimately increased to ten thousand men.
